page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 3.1 GHz. It features 20 physical cores and 40 vCPUs via hyperthreading, paired with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding 4.8 GB of memory per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a 12 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. It achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 38378.07 and a single-core score of 1438.99. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 2133.36 GB/sec and a large block uncached speed of 108.89 GB/sec. For database workloads, the server handles 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 14249.04 in PassMark database operations. In LLM inference tasks using a small 135M model, it processes prompts at 1841.39 tokens per second and generates text at 76.66 tokens per second, while a medium 7B model yields 56.94 tokens per second for prompt processing and 12.71 tokens per second for text generation.

Lacking local NVMe SSD storage and dedicated GPU hardware, this instance relies entirely on network-attached storage and CPU-based processing, which limits its suitability for heavy deep learning training or high-IOPS storage-intensive tasks. However, its dedicated high-frequency Intel Xeon processor and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offer stable, predictable compute performance. This resource profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring consistent CPU allocation without the overhead of specialized accelerators. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, static web serving, and relational database hosting.
